summary: Executed backend+frontend regression for requested refactor scope on preview. Backend core suites passed (auth/account lifecycle, payment mocking/idempotency, royalty legacy/cutoff, reset/cache/import). Found one critical auth CORS defect and remaining hardcoded test credentials in backend test sources. Frontend production build compiled cleanly; admin page smoke passed, but label support-auth smoke could not be completed with demo_vip credentials.

critical.issue: Credentialed CORS is misconfigured: Access-Control-Allow-Origin returns '*' while auth uses HttpOnly cookies. Playbook expects explicit origin + allow-credentials=true pairing.

Hardcoded credentials/secrets still exist in tracked tests (e.g., test_phase7_mda.py, test_phase8_extras.py, test_phase5_redaction_cron.py, test_phase9_autocreate.py, test_phase20_21_withdraw_fifo_rollup.py, test_refactor_smoke.py, test_phase25_label_account_lifecycle.py). Requirement to remove literals is not fully met.

minor.issue: A silent catch remains in trigger_royalty_caches() (bare except with pass), reducing observability when analytics cache trigger fails.

ui_bugs.issue: Demo label login (demo_vip) failed in smoke run, so authenticated Label Support Tickets flow could not be fully validated.

integration_issues.issue: No labels present in preview dataset, so /admin/labels/{id} detail flow could not be exercised from list click path.

Thin-route delegation for admin_update_label/admin_create_label_account/admin_revoke_label_account/admin_change_label_email is in place and verified through regression tests.
Payment fulfill flow remains idempotent in mocked-provider tests; no checkout endpoint was called during this run, preserving no-live-Xendit safety.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview currently shows empty admin label list and demo_vip login failed in UI smoke. Re-run label UI smoke after seeding a test label and validating demo credentials. Use /app/backend/tests/test_iter28_import_auth_playbook.py to reconfirm CORS + auth playbook checks.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 CORS: Runtime returns wildcard origin while issuing credential cookies, violating browser credentialed CORS constraints and auth playbook requirements. Repro: OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin=https://lanjut-core.preview.emergentagent.com returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*'. Mitigation: explicit CORS_ORIGINS/FRONTEND_URL allowlist only, no wildcard when allow_credentials=true. RCA-2 credential literals: historical tests still contain fixed passwords/tokens; scan confirms multiple files unresolved after refactor. Mitigation: route all test credentials through backend/.env.test + tests/support_config.py and sanitize literals.
